page.overview:
Who is Heino Flaxenraad?

Graf Heino Flaxenraad was the head of a House Minor.

Heino Flaxenraad had five sons. His youngest son Tamzin lived in constant fear that he would be cut off by his father if he did not live up to the expectations placed upon their family.

Tamzin was approached by the Prisoner at the Imperial Consulate in Arrakeen and told them of his fear of being disowned by his father.
